verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents built-in Comply AI features that take on specific tasks inside the product. These include automating the risk assessment workflow (inherent and residual scores, treatment, justifications), drafting and revising policies, extracting answers from vendor documents, generating IaC fixes, and generating SSPs and POA&Ms. These are narrow, feature-scoped AI automations rather than a general in-product assistant you hand open-ended tasks to. The MCP server is for external assistants and does not count toward a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or chat agent for delegating arbitrary tasks, multi-step agentic task execution across modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
